title: RepliClaw benchmark scorer output
description: One scored metric. The raw per-case table is the ground truth of the score; value/denominator must be derivable from it. Formula version pins which scorer formula produced the numbers.

metric.description: Dotted lowercase metric name, e.g. 'accuracy' or 'cost.per_correct_case'.

denominator.description: Number of cases eligible for the metric; null for non-ratio metrics. value is null iff denominator is 0 or null.

formula_version.description: Versioned formula id, e.g. 'accuracy/v1' (same {name}/{version} shape as the artifact schema strings).

per_case.description: Raw per-case rows; the authoritative record. Rows sorted by case_id.

eligible.description: Whether this case counts toward the denominator; null when eligibility is inapplicable.
